about: WGK Personal Injury Lawyers is a personal injury firm with offices in Baltimore, Dundalk and Largo.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 3 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

G1.evidence: Maryland does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: 1 of the firm's attorneys share a surname with a disciplined attorney, and for Reed J. Smith 4 of 26 decision(s) naming this surname have no searchable text, so they can be neither tied to nor ruled out against this attorney. The decisions that cannot be read are scans without searchable text, so this is a limit of the published record. Nothing here says the firm's attorney is that person.

G3.evidence: 3 physical offices confirmed through verified Google Business Profile listings, but Maryland does not publish a business register we can query, so the registered entity behind this firm is not verified here.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 7 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 1,119 public client reviews across 3 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 1998-07-10, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
